label: Pro 2.1.0
title: Search for every docs framework and language
lede: Pro 2.1.0 adds ready-made search for Docusaurus, VitePress and Astro Starlight, and a separate index and model for each language of your site. Visitors only download the model of the language they are reading.

items.title: One index per language
items.text: Give each language its own model, for example the small English model for English pages and the multilingual one for German. The language of a page comes from front matter, the file name or the folder.

items.title: Docusaurus plugin
items.text: Replaces the navbar search with Cosine and builds the index of every locale after the build, with an embedding cache so rebuilds only embed changed sections.

items.title: VitePress search field
items.text: Wrap your config and use the theme: the search field replaces the built-in search, the index is built in dev and in build, and VitePress locales map to languages.

items.title: Astro and Starlight
items.text: A Starlight plugin swaps the Pagefind search for Cosine, follows the light and dark theme and picks the index of the page language.

note: This demo cannot show the framework plugins: they need your own Docusaurus, VitePress or Astro site. The search field of the plugins was not yet tried in a real browser, hence Beta.
